title: Abandoned spaces YouTube videos
content: Hey y’all, I was watching some abandoned spaces YouTube videos last night. Not only did it remind me a lot of my Mallworld mansions and spaces, it caused some CRAZY interesting mall world experiences for me last night. I dreamed of a space that was a 1970s palace. Wall to wall red carpet, picture a 70s swinger/playboy mansion type vibe. There was an indoor swimming pool and a hot tub. Also a swanky closet and hidden bedroom. I was in a swim competition, ready to do the backstroke but I woke up before I entered the water. Saw some old classmates there that were also competing. It was a cool one!
